ai.seo_question: What does 'extending columns' refer to in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Muddaththir (74:5) highlights the grandeur and structural permanence of the afterlife realms, often interpreted as a sign of Allah's power to construct vast, enduring edifices. The elongated pillars symbolize both the magnitude of divine creation and the stability of the cosmic order, serving as a visual metaphor for the inescapable reality of the Hereafter.
